subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 7 — Object-Oriented Behavioral Modeling & Dynamic UML Design
moduleDescription: Rigorous university-standard examination of UML 2.5 behavioral and interaction modeling: Sequence Diagrams (Lifelines, Execution Specifications/Activation bars, Synchronous Calls, Asynchronous Signals, Reply Messages, and Combined Fragments: alt, opt, loop, par, critical, break), Harel Statecharts (Finite State Automata, Mealy/Moore machines, State compartments, Entry/Exit/Do internal behaviors, Guarded transitions, Choice/Junction pseudostates, Composite States with Orthogonal AND-concurrency regions, and Shallow/Deep History H/H* pseudostates), Activity Diagrams (Petri net token flow semantics, Action nodes, Control and Object flows, Pins, Decision/Merge diamonds, Fork/Join concurrency synchronization bars, Flow Final vs. Activity Final nodes, and Multi-domain Swimlane partitions), and Communication (Collaboration) Diagrams (Object roles, Association links, and Hierarchical nested sequence numbering).
